review.note: Date and act are confirmed (Act of March 4, 1929, ch. 699, 45 Stat. 1558). Open question: March 4, 1929 was inauguration day. Acts of the 70th Congress dated that day were normally signed by Coolidge before noon, but no independent record seen here names the signer. Check the Congressional Record for March 4, 1929 before naming a President.
